business_scope.primary_industry_name: Interactive Audio Chatroom and Companion Social Applications

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Spain (national unitary jurisdiction, Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law with EU supranational overlay
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Agreement between the Kingdom of Spain and the People's Republic of China for the Promotion and Reciprocal Protection of Investments (Spain-China BIT, in force)

Convention between the Kingdom of Spain and the People's Republic of China for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income and Capital (Spain-China DTA, in force)
Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (intra-EU freedoms applicable to cross-border digital services)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 10/2010, de 28 de abril, de prevención del blanqueo de capitales y de la financiación del terrorismo; Real Decreto 304/2014, de 5 de mayo, por el que se aprueba el Reglamento de la Ley 10/2010, as amended by Real Decreto 389/2021, de 1 de junio, establishing the Registro Central de Titularidades Reales; Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, de 2 de julio, por el que se aprueba el texto refundido de la Ley de Sociedades de Capital.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and constating charter/statutes of each corporate shareholder holding 25% or more
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or equivalent competent authority in the shareholder's country of domicile
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if the origin state is party to the Hague Apostille Convention); otherwise consular legalization through the competent Spanish Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / active status of each corporate shareholder
Power of Attorney (POA) under Spanish notarial standards, signed by each corporate shareholder representative and each intended manager or director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the jurisdiction where the signing party is located

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copies of passport or national identity document of every natural-person ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority / civil registry of the UBO's country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization of the notarized copy

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all identified UBOs, directors, and attorneys-in-fact against (i) the PEP definition and domestic list under Ley 10/2010 and its implementing regulation, (ii) the European Commission consolidated financial sanctions list, (iii) EU autonomous counter-terrorist measures, (iv) the United Nations Security Council consolidated list, and (v) the OFAC SDN and consolidated lists given the app's reliance on Apple IAP and Google Play Billing payment rails. The screening must be carried out at onboarding, before incorporation filing, and on an ongoing risk-based basis. Any PEP or high-risk jurisdiction match requires senior management approval, enhanced due diligence, and source-of-wealth verification.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Mercantil Central (RMC) - Denominación Social certification portal, accessible through CIRCE (Centro de Información y Red de Creación de Empresas)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be in Spanish (Castilian) or in any co-official language recognized in the autonomous community where the registered office will be located (Catalan, Basque, Galician). The name must be written in Latin/Roman script without arbitrary symbols, and foreign-language names must be adapted to Spanish orthographic rules. The corporate form 'Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada' or the abbreviation 'S.L.' must be included in the company name. Names may not be identical or phonetically/alphabetically confusingly similar to an existing registered name, nor may they mislead regarding the company's public, charitable, or professional nature.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Palabra o expresión que requiera autorización administrativa previa o que induzca a confusión con organismos públicos, actividades reguladas o marcas notorias
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The negative name certification (certificación de denominación social) is valid for 90 days and is not extendable; if incorporation is not completed within that window, a fresh application is required. Upon rejection by the Registro Mercantil Central, the applicant may, within ten working days, submit documentary evidence of consent, distinctiveness, or legal justification for reconsideration by the same Registry. If the Registry maintains the rejection, the applicant may file an administrative appeal (recurso de alzada) with the Dirección General de la Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública of the Ministry of Justice within one month of notification. The appeal must state legal grounds and attach the negative certificate, proposed name, and evidence. A subsequent challenge may be brought before the Spanish administrative courts (Audiencia Nacional or competent Juzgado de lo Contencioso-Administrativo).

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual or serviced office address is generally acceptable for registration purposes provided the SL has a genuine Spanish address for notifications and correspondence. However, Spanish corporate law (Article 9, Ley de Sociedades de Capital) requires the registered office to coincide with the place of effective management or principal establishment. Notaries and the Commercial Registry may request proof that the registered office is not fictitious. For a voice-streaming app relying on Apple IAP and Google Play Billing, a pure virtual-office arrangement without any domestic employees, management, billing records, or tax substance is likely to be challenged in a bank account application, UBO registry filing, or AEAT tax inspection. Virtual office is therefore permissible only as a gateway to a substantive Spanish operational address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate. Under a clean compliance profile and no tax red flags, the estimated annual probability of an unannounced physical on-site inspection by the Spanish Tax Agency (AEAT) or Social Security inspectorate is below 5%. If the company exhibits anomalies such as no Spanish payroll, excessive cross-border transactions without substance, continuous underreporting, or high-risk UBO profiles, the probability of a physical inspection rises to above 30%. Digital-only operators using a virtual office may receive a specific substance verification visit within the first three to twelve months of operation.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Royal Legislative Decree 1/2010 approving the Spanish Companies Act, particularly Articles 4, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 30, 32, 33, 62, 63, 210, 211, 212, 213, 214, 225 and 249, as applicable to a Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: The Provincial Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil Provincial) for the company's registered office, under the supervision of the Directorate-General for Legal Security and Public Faith.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarial public deed of incorporation (escritura pública de constitución), followed by registration with the competent Provincial Mercantile Registry. The deed incorporates the articles of association and the founding shareholders' subscription declarations.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The statutory minimum capital of an SL is EUR 1. Capital must be fully subscribed and paid at incorporation; no general escrow account is legally mandatory, although banks commonly issue a capital deposit certificate. If capital is below EUR 3,000, the company is subject to the statutory legal-reserve and shareholder-liability safeguards in Article 4 of the Companies Act until the required threshold is reached.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: The Company accepts and confirms the subscriptions and full payment of the quotas set out in the deed of incorporation and articles of association. The registered office is adopted at the address specified in the deed, with authority granted to update it in the Mercantile Registry. [Name] is appointed sole director, or the directors identified in the deed are appointed to their respective offices, each accepting the appointment and declaring eligibility. The officers are authorized to obtain tax, banking, electronic-signature, municipal and operational registrations, execute ancillary documents, and take all lawful actions necessary to commence the Company’s business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Central Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil Central), through its name-certification service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed corporate names in priority order and obtain a valid negative-name certificate. Reserve the name for the statutory validity period and ensure that the exact certified name is used in the deed, articles, tax forms and registry application.
required_dossiers: Proposed company names in priority order
Power of attorney, if filed by a representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Replace rejected or unavailable names and resubmit. If the certificate contains an error, request correction before execution of the incorporation deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish notary selected by the founders
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the articles of association, corporate purpose, registered office, share capital, quota allocation, governance structure and director appointments. Obtain Spanish tax identification numbers for foreign founders and directors where required. Foreign corporate documents must generally be legalized or apostilled, translated into Spanish by a sworn translator, and accompanied by evidence of authority and beneficial ownership.
required_dossiers: NIE or NIF documentation for foreign individuals and entities
Foreign entity certificates of incorporation and incumbency
Apostille or consular legalization and sworn translations, where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Cure documentary deficiencies through supplemental certificates, corrected translations, legalized copies or an amended power of attorney before the notarial signing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Subscribe and pay the share capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Designated Spanish credit institution and the notarial office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a provisional corporate bank account where the founders elect to use one. Deposit the subscribed capital and obtain a bank certificate, unless the founders use the statutory alternative allowing the deed to state that the founders are jointly liable for the reality of the contribution. Contributions in kind require a detailed description and valuation statement in the deed.
required_dossiers: Detailed description and valuation of any contribution in kind
Evidence of ownership and transferability for in-kind assets
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct the deposit certificate, replace non-compliant payment evidence, or amend the deed to use an available statutory capital-contribution mechanism.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execute the public deed of incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Appear personally or through a duly empowered representative. The notary verifies identity, capacity, corporate name, capital subscription, articles, director appointments, beneficial ownership and foreign-document formalities. Execute the public deed in Spanish or with an accepted bilingual arrangement and obtain an authorized electronic or paper copy.
required_dossiers: Capital evidence or statutory contribution declaration
Powers of attorney and legalized foreign corporate records
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Resolve notarial observations before signing. If execution has occurred, sign a corrective deed for material errors and submit it with the registry filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Mercantile Registry for the registered office, usually through the notary’s electronic filing channel
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Transmit the authorized deed, articles and supporting documents electronically or file them physically within the statutory presentation period. Pay the applicable Mercantile Registry tariff and request registration. The SL acquires full legal personality upon registration.
required_dossiers: Corrective or supplementary deeds, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to the registrar’s qualification notice within the stated period, correct the defect by supplementary or corrective deed, and re-present the documents. Appeal or seek judicial review of a definitive adverse qualification where appropriate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain tax identification and commence tax registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Tax Administration Agency (Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria), through Modelo 036 and its electronic office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Request the provisional NIF before or immediately after incorporation and the definitive NIF after Mercantile Registry registration. Register the activity, tax domicile, VAT status and relevant economic-activity headings. File any applicable transfer-tax or stamp-duty form, generally as an exempt transaction where required by the autonomous community.
required_dossiers: Mercantile Registry certificate or registration details
Power of attorney, if filed electronically by an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct Modelo 036 inconsistencies, provide missing identity or address evidence, and resubmit electronically or through an authorized tax representative.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete operational, employment and local registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Relevant autonomous-community authorities, Social Security General Treasury, and the municipality of the registered or operating premises
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register as an employer before hiring personnel, obtain a Social Security contribution account, enroll employees, and file the applicable municipal activity declaration or prior communication for any physical premises. For a digital voice-streaming application without manufacturing or customer-facing premises, no sector-specific industrial operating license is ordinarily required.
required_dossiers: Employer registration application, if staff are hired
Municipal activity declaration or prior communication, if premises are used
Lease or title documents for operating premises
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to municipal or Social Security requests, amend the activity classification, and obtain any premises-specific authorization before commencing the affected activity.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for the stated digital application activity. If physical technical installations, telecommunications equipment, or regulated premises are operated, the competent authority is the relevant autonomous-community industry department and the municipality where the premises are located.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No sector-specific manufacturing or industrial operating permit is ordinarily required for an interactive audio chatroom and companion social application. A municipal prior communication or activity declaration may be required for offices, studios, customer premises, or other physical facilities.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry for the Ecological Transition and the Demographic Challenge, together with the competent environmental authority of the relevant autonomous community
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Generally exempt or not applicable for software and online platform operations with no project involving listed installations, industrial emissions, waste treatment, major construction or significant land use. A project-specific screening is required if physical infrastructure falls within the Environmental Assessment Act.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No routine industrial wastewater, VOC or process-emission thresholds ordinarily apply to the stated activity. Any wastewater discharge, refrigerant handling, hazardous waste, batteries, electronic waste or backup-generator emissions must comply with applicable national, autonomous-community and municipal permits, waste-transfer documentation, and discharge or emissions limits.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No special industrial clearance is ordinarily required for a software company. Physical premises remain subject to municipal fire-safety and activity requirements, including evacuation routes, emergency planning, fire-protection systems and, where applicable, technical building-code compliance. Structural load inspections are required where equipment, server racks or alterations affect the building. Workplace risk assessment, occupational health arrangements and employee safety training are required under Spanish occupational-risk legislation.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) - Sede Electrónica, www.agenciatributaria.es
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For an ES SL: (1) obtain provisional corporate NIF (Número de Identificación Fiscal) from AEAT using Modelo 036 after the articles of association are executed and before/within registration; (2) after registration in the Registro Mercantil, request the definitive NIF (Modelo 036/037); (3) register in the Spanish Business Census (Censo de empresarios) simultaneously, thereby obtaining a VAT identification number (NIF-IVA); (4) a Spanish-resident SL is statutorily a taxable person under IVA from day one with no economic turnover threshold; (5) non-resident shareholders require an NIE (Número de Identificación de Extranjero) before the notary; a non-resident entity without a permanent establishment must obtain a non-resident NIF via a tax representative (Modelo 030) and, if making distance B2C sales to Spanish customers, may register for IVA through the OSS/IOSS scheme.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Spain does not operate a U.S.-style check-the-box regime; an SL is automatically classified as a resident corporation for income tax and as a taxable person for VAT, with no entity classification election. Applicable statutory elections include: (i) Union One-Stop-Shop (OSS) selection for intra-EU B2C distance sales and e-services; (ii) Non-Union OSS for certain B2C digital services to Spanish consumers by non-EU suppliers; (iii) monthly VAT filing option (Modelo 308) rather than quarterly; (iv) optional VAT fiscal group treatment (grupo de entidades, Art. 9.3 LIVA) where a controlling interest exists; and (v) obligatory, non-elective documentation and tax treatment for hybrid-mismatch transactions under ATAD/ATAD II, with no check-the-box variant available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) – Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido (IVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No de minimis economic-turnover threshold for an established Spanish SL; registration is compulsory before any taxable supply in the Spanish territory. For non-established foreign suppliers of cross-border B2C digital services (including voice-streaming apps), Spain imposes no separate national turnover threshold either. Under the EU Union OSS, an EU-established business remains taxable in its State of establishment for intra-EU supplies until annual cross-border distance sales of goods and e-services to consumers exceed EUR 10,000 (excluding VAT), at which point registration in the customer State becomes mandatory and the OSS election is the statutory mechanism.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Spain does not currently operate a universal real-time invoice-stamping/clearance system analogous to Italy's SdI, but the following electronic fiscal controls apply: (1) the SII (Suministro Inmediato de Información) requires taxpayers with annual turnover above EUR 6,000,000, VAT groups, monthly-refund registrants and certain consortia to transmit invoice and received-invoice data to AEAT within 4 calendar days; (2) under Real Decreto 1007/2023 (Verifactu), billing software and workflows must be certified to ensure invoice authenticity, integrity, legibility and immediate transmission of records to AEAT upon request; (3) the 'Crea y Crece' law mandates interoperable B2B e-invoicing (Facturae or equivalent) between entrepreneurs and professionals once the relevant final implementation order is issued, with a transition scheme; (4) self-issued invoices (e.g., reverse-charge calls) remain subject to the same integrity rules, and the Basque Country/Navarra foral territories operate TicketBai/TaxBAI real-time invoice declaration systems.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: For goods physically exported from the Spanish customs territory to a third country, zero-rating (exención plena, with right to deduction) applies under Art. 21 LIVA where the exporter proves the definitive exit of the goods and retains the customs export declaration and transport documentation. For the voice-streaming/e-digital services of an ES SL: (a) B2B services supplied to a non-resident entrepreneur established outside Spain are zero-rated where that customer is established outside the Tax Administration Area and the service is not used in Spain, evidenced by the customer's foreign VAT registration number or certificate of fiscal residence; (b) B2C electronically supplied services (audio streaming, social audio functions) follow the place-of-supply B2C rule — for consumers established outside the EU/Spain the supply is situated outside the Spanish VAT territory and may be issued without IVA, with two non-contradictory proofs (e.g., IP address, billing address, bank card data, pre-paid SIM registration); (c) intra-EU B2C supplies are taxable in the recipient's EU Member State under the Union OSS once the EU-wide EUR 10,000 cross-border threshold is exceeded; below that threshold, the Spanish SL may retain charging Spanish IVA at 21% unless the OSS election is made.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Single Administrative Document / DUDA file)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical exit from the EU customs territory
Inward Remittance Certificate or foreign-currency bank credit confirmation
Commercial invoice marked 'IVA NO DEVENGADO — ART.21 LIVA' or place-of-supply substantiation
Transport contract (CMR, POD) and Incoterms® 2020 terms confirming risk transfer
Export license or authorized exporter status document where applicable

For digital e-services: IP-address logs, geolocation data, customer residence certificate, payment gateway billing address, and device/phone registration records proving the customer's place of supply outside Spain/EU
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: If a zero-rated export transaction is not properly substantiated within the four-year statutory documents-retention period (Arts. 70 and 112 LGT; Art. 114 LIVA and RD 1624/1992), AEAT will retroactively assess IVA at the applicable rate (currently 21%) plus default interest from the original invoice date. Tax penalties under LGT Arts. 191–193 range from 50% to 150% of the amount evaded in the case of false or inaccurate zero-rating; where the fraudulent export scheme causes aggregate tax damage exceeding EUR 120,000, it may constitute a criminal offence under Criminal Code Art. 305, carrying imprisonment of one to five years and a fine of two to six times the defrauded amount. AEAT's SII/Verifactu real-time audit capabilities and cross-matching with consignment records in EU customs databases mean any artificial or unsupported export substantiation triggers immediate clawbacks, exclusion from the quarterly/monthly VAT refund system, and coordinated civil/criminal enforcement.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain operates within the European Economic Area and the eurozone, with full current-account and capital-account convertibility for resident and non-resident entities. No prior administrative authorization is required for capital movements to or from EU/EEA member states. For transactions with non-EU jurisdictions, only statistical reporting (declaraciones informativas) and, where applicable, anti-money laundering declarations are required for amounts exceeding €50,000 or under other threshold rules. Profit remittance to non-resident shareholders is unrestricted, subject to corporate income tax withholding recovery or treaty relief, and supported by proof of tax residence and beneficial ownership documentation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory surrender or mandatory conversion rule for export proceeds in Spain. Receipts in foreign currency may be retained, converted freely, or credited to external accounts at market rates. Under Royal Decree 2071/1998 and Banco de España Circular rules, resident companies must file balance-of-payments statistical declarations for transactions exceeding €50,000 (or equivalent), including export/import payments, but no mandatory timeline for repatriation or conversion ratio applies.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium. EU-licensed Electronic Money Institutions (EMI) may passport into Spain under the Payment Services Directive (PSD2) and can provide multi-currency IBANs, virtual accounts, and cross-border liquidity rails. Non-EU fintech/EMIs without a licence, branch, or appointed agent in Spain cannot lawfully onboard a Spanish SL as a primary payments counterparty or provide unregulated escrow services. Due diligence stronger in practice on fintechs without full banking licence; a Tier-1 Spanish bank or an EU banking-licensed institution with a Spanish branch is recommended for capital escrow and settlement accounts.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Spanish AML law (Ley 10/2010) requires financial institutions to identify the ultimate beneficial owners and the legal representative(s) of a corporate client. While fully remote onboarding exists in some banks using video/behavioural biometrics and qualified electronic signatures, most Tier-1 banks will require a physical or authenticated notarial interview for a foreign-owned SL, especially when directors are non-residents without a Spanish national identity number (NIE). A registered proxy with a notarial power of attorney in Spanish may reduce or eliminate the need for physical travel, but banks generally retain the right to request a video call or a branch appearance for enhanced due diligence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident corporate directors and ultimate beneficial owners domiciled in jurisdictions with opaque ownership registries
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled certificate of incorporation, current registry of beneficial owners (Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada public deed), identification of every UBO with passport copies and utility bills, notarised power of attorney in Spanish, and a written explanation of the commercial substance of voice streaming operations in Spain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume microtransactions from digital platforms (Apple IAP / Google Play Billing) flagged as potential fungible value transfer
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited platform revenue reports, contractual agreements with app stores, a recurring AML operational policy addressing app-store deduction reconciliation, transaction monitoring logs, and a cash-flow projection demonstrating expected settlement cycles and refund rules.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ownership concentration and crypto-asset or fintech legacy exposure in the shareholder chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent source-of-wealth report, audited financial statements of shareholders, exchange and fintech transaction history showing provenance of injected capital, and a sworn declaration of no sanctioned activities with supporting sanctions screening certificates from a reputable screening provider.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity injections to the Spanish SL are executed via SWIFT MT103 with clear narrative reference 'Capital Sustantivo / Inversión Extranjera' and the relevant Banco de España balance-of-payments statistical purpose code (e.g., 'Inversión directa de no residente en entidades residentes'). The routing must include a valid Spanish IBAN (ES-code), the SL's tax ID (CIF/NIF), and the reference to the notarial deed and registry appointment (nombramiento). Funds originating from outside the EU may require additional supporting documents: apostilled source of funds disclosure, proof of beneficial owner identity, and the Escritura de Constitución. Amounts above €1 million or with high-risk origins may trigger enhanced due diligence and a potential hold pending review by the bank's compliance department.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Operational and trade-related outflows are cleared via SWIFT MT103 for standard invoice settlements, licensing fees, infrastructure costs, and contractor payments. Commercial Letters of Credit (UCP 600) are used where counterparties demand documentary instruments against shipment or services; the Spanish SL's account bank will require the underlying commercial contract, invoice, bill of lading or proof-of-service, and any relevant compliance annex. SEPA (SCT and SDD Core) rails are available for beneficiary accounts in the EU/EEA, and instant payment (SCT Inst) can be used for high-velocity low-value settlements, though Apple IAP and Google Play Billing proceeds arrive via platform remittances using SWIFT or local automated clearing house (ACH) equivalents, typically in EUR.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for inconvertible or thinly traded emerging-market currencies
EUR/USD and EUR/LATAM currency options (call/spread) for hedging receivables from Latin American markets
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCIRS) for non-EUR debt refinancing
Currency futures traded on regulated EU exchanges (e.g., Eurex) or OTC with qualified bank counterparties

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements (Cuentas Anuales) – approval and deposit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Mercantil (Commercial Registry) of the province of the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For 31 December year-end: shareholders' approval by 30 June; deposit at the Commercial Registry within one month from approval, i.e. by 31 July.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of EUR 200 to EUR 300,000 under the ICAC late-filing regime; Commercial Registry file closure (cierre registral) until accounts and audit report (if applicable) are deposited.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For 31 December year-end: on or before 25 July; for other tax periods, within 6 months and 25 days after the close of the tax period.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge of 5% to 20% of the self-assessed tax due plus late-payment interest; proportional penalty of 50% to 150% on regularized amounts under Law 58/2003.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Third-Party Transactions Information Return – Modelo 347
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By 1 March following the calendar year in which aggregated transactions with any customer or supplier exceeded EUR 3,005.06.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalties under LGT Articles 198-200: EUR 150 to EUR 20,000, or proportional 0.5% of the net value of unreported operations in cases of inaccurate or incomplete filings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Mercantil / Registro Central de Beneficiarios Finales
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Embedded in the annual accounts deposit due by 31 July; any change in the beneficial-ownership structure must be notified within 10 business days of the corporate event.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalties under Spain's AML Law 10/2010 (up to EUR 600,000 for serious infringements) and blocking of further Mercantile Registry filings until the UBO declaration is updated.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit if at least two of the following are exceeded for two consecutive years: total assets greater than EUR 2,850,000; net annual turnover greater than EUR 5,700,000; average workforce greater than 50 employees. Audit is also required for certain public-interest entities, group consolidation situations, or when ordered by a court.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish General Accounting Plan (Plan General Contable) under Royal Decree 1514/2007, as amended by Royal Decree 1/2021; consolidated financial statements follow EU-endorsed IFRS; individual SL accounts use local GAAP (PGC).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: There is no standalone annual UBO tax return; beneficial-ownership information is confirmed annually as part of the deposit of annual accounts. The SL must maintain a record of direct shareholders and ultimate final owners and must report any shareholding transfer to the Commercial Registry within 10 business days. Non-confirmation triggers cierre registral and AML fines under Law 10/2010.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro Registro de Socios)
Register of Directors (Libro de Actas del Órgano de Administración)
Book of Inventories and Annual Accounts (Libro de Inventarios y Cuentas Anuales)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 800 - 2,200 per year for registered office, legal representation and administrative compliance support
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,200 - 5,500 per year for a statutory audit of a small or mid-sized SL

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% rate for newly created companies in the first two taxable periods with positive tax base (taxable base up to €300,000; excess taxed at 25%). Applicable incentives: R&D tax credit, human resources innovation credit, patent box exemption (50%), and, from 2021, the digital services tax (3%) applies separately to certain digital revenues.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: unlimited (indefinite as per Article 26 LIS; no time cap since 2014; limited offset percentages apply for companies with net turnover ≥ €20 million)

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Modelo 200 (Impuesto sobre Sociedades); submitted electronically through the AEAT Sede Electrónica.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (quarterly instalment payments via Modelo 202 also apply certain taxpayers)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 25 days and 6 months after the end of the fiscal year (i.e., by 25 July for calendar year-end entities).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net accounting result (resultado contable) before statutory adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report the company's P&L result; no direct remittance effects.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Positive tax adjustments (extra-contable increases), e.g., non-deductible provisions/depreciation, transfer pricing corrections.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include disallowed items and adjustments for related-party transactions under Article 18 LIS.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable base (base imponible) after the offset of prior-year tax losses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply offset in accordance with the unlimited carry-forward rule; retain supporting computations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable tax rate(s) - general 25%, reduced 15% for eligible newly created entities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Select the rate corresponding to Article 29 LIS; keep proof of new-entity qualification.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Domestic tax credits, withholdings, instalment payments and resulting tax payable or refundable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach withholding evidence (Modelo 296/297) and apply any treaty-based relief where appropriate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing without prior request triggers surcharges under Article 27 LGT: 10% within 6 months, 15% between 6 and 12 months, 20% thereafter, plus late-payment interest. Filing a false or incomplete return is a serious infringement: administrative penalties from 75% to 150% of the tax loss or, in absence of loss, fixed penalties from €200 to €600; potential criminal referral if the amount exceeds €120,000.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 19% for beneficiaries resident in EU/EEA states (or with treaty entitlement); 24% generally for non-residents without treaty/EU status; reduced to 0% under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive for qualifying corporate holdings (≥5% for ≥12 months).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The foreign recipient must obtain an official tax residence certificate (TRC) for the relevant calendar year and provide it to the Spanish paying entity before distribution. The payer applies the treaty rate and must evidence the TRC and computation in its annual withholding summary (Modelo 216). If excess tax is withheld, the non-resident may submit a refund application via Modelo 210 within 4 years of the payment date.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Interest: statutory 19% for EU/EEA residents, 24% otherwise; royalties: statutory 24% (EU/EEA reduced where applicable; the EU Interest and Royalties Directive allows 0% for qualifying associated companies). Bilateral treaty rates typically range 0%–10% depending on the DTA.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File and Master File preparation is required if net turnover exceeds EUR 10 million, or if related-party transactions with any single counterparty exceed EUR 250,000 in a tax year. Country-by-country reporting applies to groups with consolidated revenue of at least EUR 750 million.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Spain does not impose Gulf-style Economic Substance Regulations. However, substance principles are embedded in the GAAR (Article 15 LIS), the Spanish ETVE privileged regime (EC Decision of EU), the participation exemption (5% holding, ≥1-year holding, no asset-driven tax avoidance), and financing/treaty claims. Lack of economic substance can trigger recharacterisation, denial of treaty benefits, and penalties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Wilful omission or false declarations of Spanish-source income, inflating deductions, or using sham invoices in the voice-streaming business where annual economic prejudice exceeds €120,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative penalty of 75%–150% of the loss; criminal sanction under Article 305 of the Spanish Criminal Code: imprisonment from 1 to 6 years, fine up to six times the evaded amount.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorised or participated are jointly and severally liable under Article 40.2 LGT for unpaid corporate tax and penalties; may face travel bans within Schengen territory and disqualification for company administration.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: A Spanish SL serving as a nominal owner of the app while all substance remains in a zero-tax jurisdiction, with no real premises, employees, or decision-making in Spain.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Recharacterisation of the structure by the AEAT; denial of deduction of intra-group payments; penalty of 75%–150% of the reassessed amount; if the artificiality is used to evade tax, criminal exposure under the Criminal Code.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can be personally liable for the tax debt (Article 42 LGT) and, in serious cases, criminally liable for structuring a sham entity; court may impose 5-year ban on company administration and temporary seizure of property.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating in-app payment rails (Apple IAP / Google Play Billing) without implementing KYC/CDD obligations or filing suspicious activity reports (SAR) to SEPBLAC, especially when users can obfuscate identity or use digital assets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Law 10/2010 penalties: serious violations from €120,000 to €1,500,000; money-laundering criminal offence under Article 301 of the Criminal Code with imprisonment of 1 to 6 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Board members and the appointed compliance officer may be jointly and severally liable for corporate fines; personal interdictions, asset freezes, and European Arrest Warrant arrest for money-laundering participation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to prepare or file the required TP Local File/Master File, or omitting intercompany payments (e.g., IP royalties to a foreign parent) from the annual Form 232 declaration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Specific penalty under the LGT: up to 15% of the amount of related-party operations (5% if conformed promptly); a secondary adjustment can trigger an additional corporate tax assessment of 75%–150%.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign, or direct the preparation of, the flawed return are jointly liable for the penalty under Articles 42 and 44 LGT and may also face criminal consequences for fraudulent tax filings.
